A method for creating a protected exchange link via a digital data network, the method comprising:
(a) initializing a cryptographic context by instantiating a secure communication entity provisioned with a lowest-permitted protocol revision and importing at least one certification authority trust credential
(b) establishing mutually agreed encryption configuration settings between a client apparatus and a server apparatus,
wherein said negotiating comprises determining, from among a plurality of available cryptographic option combinations, a particular cryptographic option combination in accordance with a threshold requirement for key size
(c) conducting a mutual initialization procedure between the client apparatus and the server apparatus to derive session cryptographic keys
(d) validating a hierarchical sequence of credentials furnished by the server device, wherein said validating comprises:
(i) verifying that an identifier of the server device corresponds to a subject alternative designation or principal designation contained within a server credential
(ii) verifying that the certificate of said server remains within its validity period
(iii) verifying that key utilization extensions within the server credential authorize server-side authentication
(e) conveying application-layer information through a cryptographically protected communication path utilizing the previously established session cryptographic keys,
wherein the entirety of information conveyed between said client apparatus and said server apparatus is subject to cryptographic protection employing the mutually agreed cipher suite
